note: LV01 v2 asks whether contemporaneous ledgers help predict receiver behavior at the final training cutoff. That design cannot answer whether revision histories make development inspectable over time: a final ledger explaining earlier actions is retrospective, and a single-cutoff contrast cannot show how predictive value changes as meanings develop. LV02 is the planned chronological study that closes that gap with five frozen checkpoints, preceding-data-only fitting, and a current-versus-stale prospective contrast.
